rounds.response:
Quick answers to each point:

- For R-squared = 0.58 you can write: "Hours studied explains 58% of the variation in exam scores (i.e., 58% of the variability in scores across students is associated with differences in hours studied)." Avoid implying causation unless the study design supports it.  
- You do not need to standardize predictors for the assignment unless the instructions say to; use the raw scores (standardizing only changes coefficient scales and is mainly for comparing effect sizes).  
- A curved pattern in the residual plot suggests the linearity assumption may be violated—report that pattern and, if asked to assess model fit, note you might try a quadratic term or a transformation as a follow-up.  
- For the deadline discrepancy, follow the date/time shown on the assignment page; I will notify the instructor to confirm and will update you if they respond.
